title: Rute /studio/batch: enqueue/list/retry/delete + unduh ZIP / /studio/batch route: enqueue/list/retry/delete plus ZIP download
summary: ID: Rute admin baru /studio/batch untuk generate batch hingga 50 prompt: validasi, antrean, riwayat, retry, hapus, unduh ZIP. / EN: New admin route /studio/batch for batch generation of up to 50 prompts: validation, queueing, history, retry, delete, ZIP download.
problem_before: ID: Studio hanya melayani 1 prompt per generate; kebutuhan volume (50 varian) tak terlayani. / EN: Studio served 1 prompt per generation; volume needs (50 variants) were unserved.
solution: ID: Server action enqueueStudioBatch/listBatchImages/retryFailedBatchImages/deleteStudioBatch + tabel studio_batches (migrasi 20260929000001 applied prod via MCP) + BatchForm/BatchHistory/BatchPageClient + item sidebar studioBatch + i18n id/en + ZIP via JSZip dynamic import. / EN: New enqueueStudioBatch/listBatchImages/retryFailedBatchImages/deleteStudioBatch server actions plus the studio_batches table (migration 20260929000001 applied to prod via MCP) plus BatchForm/BatchHistory/BatchPageClient plus a studioBatch sidebar item plus id/en i18n plus ZIP via dynamic JSZip import.
reason: ID: Batch mempercepat produksi varian visual dengan tetap menghormati kuota harian dan cap 50 prompt. / EN: Batching speeds visual-variant production while respecting the daily quota and the 50-prompt cap.
user_impact: ID: Admin bisa enqueue banyak prompt sekaligus, pantau progres per batch, unduh semua (.zip). / EN: Admins can enqueue many prompts at once, track per-batch progress, and download all (.zip).
tech_impact: ID: Tabel studio_batches + knob max_batch_prompts=50 + kolom batch_id + 2 index + 4 policy RLS; Batch V1 tak mendukung gambar referensi (img2img). / EN: New studio_batches table plus max_batch_prompts=50 knob plus batch_id column plus 2 indexes plus 4 RLS policies; Batch V1 does not support reference images (img2img).
